line: Stacks On Deck tatted on my face
vault_lines: Stacks On Deck tatted on my face
meaning: Stacks on Deck Money Gang Entertainment is Soulja Boy’s label, which D.Flores is signed to. You can also see “S.O.D.” tatted on his eyebrow, which is short for Stacks on Deck.

line: Cut a lot of niggas off, ain’t no room for snakes
vault_lines: Cut a lot of niggas off, ain't no room for snakes
meaning: Here, D.Flores is talking about the metaphor “snakes in the grass”, the snake being a shady person that could backstab you at any time. When he says “cut a lot of niggas off”, he’s saying he’s going to cut the “grass” so he can see where the “snakes” are.

line: I’ll let it blow (x2) You talkin’ about my money, I’mma let it blow I’ll let it blow (x2) Nigga disrespect me, I’mma let it blow I’ma let it blow (x2) Nigga play with me, I’mma let it blow I’ll let it blow (x2) All of my niggas aim, I’ll let them go
meaning: If you do anything bad or talk any shit about D.Flores, he’s going shoot you. He’s also saying that has shooters, so, if he doesn’t want to, he doesn’t have to shoot you himself.

line: Just got a house in Beverly, call it my hills, bitch (Know how I rock)
vault_lines: Just got a house in Beverly, call it my hills, bitch (Know how I rock)
meaning: Beverly is one of the nicest parts of South Side Chicago, which isn’t saying much, but still, it’s pretty nice. Keef tries to sound clever here by calling it his hills, so it’s his equivalent to Beverly Hills, California.

line: Shoot him in the head, put him in the lake
vault_lines: Shoot him in the head, put him in the lake
meaning: After murdering someone, it is common to leave their body in a lake so no one will find it. Unfortunately for D. Flores, he lives in Las Vegas, where there are no lakes. Maybe he could use the Hoover Dam instead?
